title: Tunisian Tagine Stuffed Quenched Grain
description: A Chinese take on the traditional North African dish, with a twist of stuffed quenched grain and tunisian spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add tagine and cook for 1 minute.
Add quenched grain and stir to coat with spices.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
Stir in chopped cilantro and season with salt.
